status: engineering stop condition; not a theorem of developmental closure
default: stop an actor's supplied demand after two exactly equal successive scoped retained payloads from successful nonpublic, nonmaterial native movements
evidence: Both paid outputs and all charges remain in history. Actor, context, target and full proposition relation/object content form the compared signature. The signature is a diagnostic index, not history replacement.
meaning: unchanged_retained_result means this run stops repeating the current demand. It does not mean the content is true, the actor has developed, or all future work is exhausted.
monitoring: repeat_limit=null intentionally disables this stop for 24-episode diagnostic runs
measuring: 2 and 3 actors; stop and monitor modes; two independent timing processes and one traced process per configuration; exact restore and raw reconstruction. Report actual work and distinct scoped payloads. No same-semantics speedup claim.
